channel.title: Binding Wire Machine - Industrial Machinery Catalog
channel.description: Manufacturer and exporter of high-speed Automatic Wire Nail Making Machines, Continuous Wire Drawing Plants, and Binding Wire Machinery in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

item.g:title: IN1+ Automatic Wire Nail Making Machine (1/2" to 1")
item.g:description: High-speed automatic wire nail making machine model IN1+ engineered for producing small, high-precision nails from 1/2 inch to 1 inch (12 mm to 25 mm). Features heavy-duty crank structure, automatic centralized lubrication, and 550 nails/min production speed.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Fastener Machinery > Wire Nail Making Machines

item.g:title: IN3 Automatic Wire Nail Making Machine (1" to 3")
item.g:description: Industry standard IN3 automatic wire nail making machine for versatile wire nail production from 1 inch to 3 inches (25 mm to 75 mm). Heavy-duty alloy casting, tungsten carbide tooling, 350 nails/min output, and 3.0 HP 3-Phase motor.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Fastener Machinery > Wire Nail Making Machines

item.g:title: IN4 Heavy Duty Automatic Wire Nail Making Machine (2" to 4")
item.g:description: Heavy-duty IN4 automatic wire nail machine engineered for continuous manufacturing of 2 inch to 4 inch (50 mm to 100 mm) construction nails. Operates at 250 nails/min using 8 to 12 SWG mild steel wire with a 5.0 HP motor.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Fastener Machinery > Wire Nail Making Machines

item.g:title: IN6 Heavy Duty Automatic Wire Nail Machine (3" to 6")
item.g:description: High-capacity IN6 heavy-duty nail making machine engineered for large nails from 3 inches to 6 inches (75 mm to 150 mm). 150 nails/min output, 7.5 HP 3-Phase motor, hardened tool steel dies, and centralized lubrication.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Fastener Machinery > Wire Nail Making Machines

item.g:title: 600mm Continuous Multi-Die Wire Drawing Machine Plant
item.g:description: Heavy-duty continuous wire drawing line plant for mild steel (MS), hard bright (HB), and high-carbon wire reduction. Includes water-cooled drums, tungsten carbide dies, pay-off unit, and variable frequency drive (VFD) panel.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Wire Processing > Wire Drawing Machines

item.g:title: Automatic Binding Wire Making Plant Setup (16 to 22 SWG)
item.g:description: Complete industrial plant setup for manufacturing annealed black binding wire and galvanized construction tie wire. Includes fine wire drawing blocks, pit-type electric annealing furnace, and automatic weight-based coiler.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Wire Processing > Binding Wire Plants

item.g:title: Industrial Wire Nail Polishing Barrel Drum (500 Kg Batch)
item.g:description: Heavy-duty hexagonal rotary polishing barrel drum for de-burring, cleaning, and mirror-finishing wire nails with sawdust and leather scrap. Low power consumption, heavy load capacity, and 500 Kg per batch cycle.
item.g:product_type: Industrial Machinery > Finishing > Polishing Barrel Drums

item.g:title: Precision Wire Nail Cutter Grinder Machine for Dies
item.g:description: Dedicated die and blade sharpening machine engineered for precision re-grinding of wire nail cutting knives, gripper dies, and header punches. Extends die service life and ensures burr-free nail cuts.
